authority_note: This record qualifies sources and reconstruction limits. It contains no forward-outcome statistic and grants no production authority.
known_methodological_seams: Current breadth history is reconstructed from the present curated large-cap roster; historical membership is unavailable.
Generic Eastmoney China macro stores are reference-date/current-vintage histories, not published-at/revision vintages.

Current Market State trend path calls cycles.mtf_snapshot without market=CN, so its 3-session leg uses the default US session anchor; exact-production and CN-anchor sensitivity must be reported separately.
Slowdown information is carried in both liquidity and stress, and stress drawdown construction itself includes slowdown; component independence must not be assumed.
Top-level availability and subleg composition change over history; renormalized early history is not the exact current issued model.
HG_F and GC_F blobs contain rows through 2026-09-25 at preregistration, but P3 sample_end is frozen to 2026-09-24 and later rows are excluded.
